owner: Dr Aden Tran and Dr AJ Ambikairajah
summary: A Mosman practice offering cosmetic and implant work is a strength, but typos in the menu and no patient reviews appear to cost you high value patients.

findings.problem: The cosmetic menu appears to read 'Smile Rejunvenation', a case study appears to say 'antiobiotic therapy', and an image caption appears as 'whit his whitened teeth'.
findings.cost: Typos in a clinical brand make a patient doubt the care they will receive.

findings.problem: Book Now and Book an Appointment appear to link to a contact page, and the form asks 'What do you want to do?', so booking depends on a manual reply.
findings.cost: High value patients who expect to book online may not wait for a reply.
findings.fix: A real online booking flow with clear time choices.

findings.problem: No patient reviews or ratings appear, and only four case studies appear with short text ending in dots, naming patients by first name only.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients choose by proof, and thin proof loses them to a competitor.
findings.fix: Real reviews with ratings and full before and after cases.

findings.problem: Several images appear to carry empty descriptions, and the hero copy appears generic ('friendly family practice') with no call now button near the top.
findings.cost: A generic first impression does not signal a premium cosmetic practice.
findings.fix: A premium hero message and a clear call button.

redesign: Reviews, full cases and a stronger first impression.
